title: Session page has no title and puts editing above the results
what_happens: The header is only the code in small caps and 'open · date'. The topic (what the session asks) only appears inside the Topic input. Order is: Send on WhatsApp, a ~3000px Edit form, Privacy, Archive, then Voices and Themes at the bottom (page is 7540px tall). Theme counts ('38') have no label.
who_hurts: Anyone opening a session to see how it is going has to scroll past a live 'Send invites' and a long form to reach voices and themes, and can't tell at a glance which question this is. It also makes accidental edits/sends more likely.
suggested_fix: Add an h1 with the topic (code + status under it), move Voices and Themes up under the header, and collapse the Edit form behind a 'Edit session' disclosure like 'Prompt overrides' already is. Label theme counts ('38 points'). page.tsx:107-224.
rule: established pattern: the Sessions list and Synthesis pages both have an h1
